name: 💘 High School Football  🏈
desc:
🔥 • Welcome to Under The Lights V3, the most realistic high school football experience on roblox!

🎯 • This game is based on real-life high school football. Step into the cleats of some of the most well-known high schools across the nation. Compete under the Friday night lights, earn ⭐ stars, attend 🏕️ camps, and work your way toward receiving 🎓 D1 offers.

⚡ • Play with friends, build your legacy, and experience the grind of going from a Friday night standout to a Division 1 recruit.

🛠️ • (Reminder, this game is still in alpha. The game is still receiving updates and gets fix updates weekly)
